provider_freeze.github_authentication: local gh credential used only for public API rate allowance; no secret retained
provider_freeze.bounded_sample_rule: exactly the first Crossref page of at most 200 unique JOSS publication DOIs under the frozen query; no replacement or extra query after failures

domain_lexicon.rule: case-insensitive substring matches over JOSS title/abstract plus GitHub description/topics; assign the unique domain with the greatest number of distinct matched tokens
domain_lexicon.authority_boundary: discovery classification only; external adjudication remains required

strict_candidate_unit.identity: one unique tuple of normalized JOSS publication DOI and case-folded GitHub repository full_name; at most the latest GitHub release is retained for transport evidence
all_required: unique JOSS publication DOI from the frozen Crossref page
JOSS page exposes a labelled software-repository relation to exactly one GitHub repository
GitHub repository full_name and numeric repository id are bound
latest non-draft GitHub release id and tag are bound
release tag resolves to an immutable commit SHA, dereferencing annotated tags
license endpoint at that exact release tag returns an accepted non-NOASSERTION SPDX identifier and license blob SHA
release tarball_url is an HTTPS transport identity
repository is neither archived nor disabled at capture
frozen domain rule yields exactly one domain
no duplicate publication DOI or repository concept identity within or across cells
not_independent_units: GitHub repositories without a qualifying release
releases or tags of the same repository concept
strict_candidate_unit.publication_release_version_boundary: JOSS-to-repository relation plus a current immutable release establishes a publication-linked software concept and transport candidate, not that the release bytes are the exact version evaluated by the paper; exact paper-to-release version alignment remains CANNOT_CHECK unless explicitly asserted
strict_candidate_unit.natural_pair_boundary: metadata qualification never establishes same-claim preservation, the one-coordinate intervention, author-lineage independence, scientific resolvability, or natural-pair eligibility

provider_independence.not_independent_within_family: multiple GitHub repositories, JOSS papers, releases, tags or organizations remain one provider family for the replication gate
provider_independence.author_lineage: normalized JOSS authors and GitHub owner are retained as audit fields; absence of a collision is not treated as proof of source-author independence

decision_rule.positive_source_frame_if: after union with immutable V3 strict units, every M6 cell has at least 48 unique candidate concepts and at least 8 units from a provider family disjoint from its primary family, with all identity, relation, rights, transport and domain gates satisfied
decision_rule.shortfall_if: a completed bounded harvest leaves any M6 cell below 48 or below 8 provider-family-disjoint units
decision_rule.cannot_check_if: transport failures or ambiguity prevent complete evaluation of the frozen Crossref page
forbidden_positive_claims: quota passage from search hits or versions
